effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 2 of 5 is on now: Team J (Hanta Sero and the player) as heroes against Team E (Yuga Aoyama and Mina Ashido) as villains. The player fights in it with Hanta Sero as Team J, two against two; Eijiro Kirishima is not in it and watches from the Monitoring Room. Only Yuga Aoyama and Mina Ashido are villains; nobody else joins them. Already fought, never again: Teams A, D. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team B (Shoto Todoroki and Mezo Shoji) against Team I (Mashirao Ojiro and Toru Hagakure); Teams A, D, J, E are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 3 more rounds remain. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.
